import tensorflow as tf

x = tf.placeholder(tf.float32, shape=[None, 1])
y_true = tf.placeholder(tf.float32, shape=[None, 1])

w = tf.get_variable("w", shape=[1, 1],
                    initializer=tf.random_normal_initializer())
y_pred = tf.matmul(x, w)
loss = tf.reduce_mean(tf.square(y_pred - y_true))

optimizer = tf.train.GradientDescentOptimizer(0.1)
train_op = optimizer.minimize(loss)

with tf.Session() as sess:
    sess.run(tf.global_variables_initializer())
    for step in range(10):
        _, l = sess.run(
            [train_op, loss],
            feed_dict={x: [[1.0]], y_true: [[2.0]]}
        )
        print(step, l)

import tensorflow as tf

w = tf.Variable(tf.random.normal([1, 1]))
optimizer = tf.keras.optimizers.SGD(0.1)

for step in range(10):
    with tf.GradientTape() as tape:
        x = tf.constant([[1.0]])
        y_true = tf.constant([[2.0]])
        y_pred = tf.matmul(x, w)
        loss = tf.reduce_mean(tf.square(y_pred - y_true))

    grads = tape.gradient(loss, [w])
    optimizer.apply_gradients(zip(grads, [w]))
    print(step, loss.numpy())

class MyLayer(tf.layers.Layer):
    def __init__(self, units=32):
        super(MyLayer, self).__init__()
        self.units = units

    def build(self, input_shape):

        )

            name="b",
            shape=[self.units],
            initializer=tf.zeros_initializer()
        )

    def call(self, inputs):

import tensorflow as tf

class MyLayer(tf.keras.layers.Layer):
    def __init__(self, units=32):
        super().__init__()
        self.units = units

    def build(self, input_shape):
        self.w = self.add_weight(
            shape=(input_shape[-1], self.units),
            initializer="random_normal",
            trainable=True,
            name="w",
        )
        self.b = self.add_weight(
            shape=(self.units,),
            initializer="zeros",
            trainable=True,
            name="b",
        )

    def call(self, inputs):
        return tf.matmul(inputs, self.w) + self.b

layer = MyLayer(3)
y = layer(tf.constant([[1.0, 2.0, 3.0, 4.0]]))
print(y.numpy())
expected_changes: Replaced tf.layers.Layer subclassing with tf.keras.layers.Layer subclassing
Replaced add_variable with add_weight for defining trainable parameters
Replaced tf.placeholder with a concrete tf.constant input when calling the layer
Removed tf.Session, tf.global_variables_initializer, and feed_dict; layer is executed eagerly and Tensor.numpy() is used to print the result
